cases.name: ABL T315I — Imatinib resistance
cases.literature: O'Hare et al., Nat Rev Cancer 2007 — T315I drives near-total Imatinib loss in CML; >400-fold IC50 shift in cellular assays.
cases.verdict_note: Δ=+2.40 kcal/mol matches expected 'resistance' — clean signal well above noise floor (was NOISE before OpenMM minimisation step landed)

cases.name: EGFR T790M — Osimertinib retains/gains
cases.literature: Cross et al., Cancer Discov 2014 — Osimertinib (AZD9291) retains potency against T790M; cellular IC50 ~1 nM vs T790M.
cases.caveat: Osimertinib is a covalent acrylamide on C797. Vina is non-covalent — magnitude will be smaller than IC50 shifts suggest, but the geometric T790M preference still produces a measurable ΔΔG.
cases.verdict_note: |Δ|=0.10 below ±1.0 kcal/mol noise floor — covalent mechanism not modelled by Vina

cases.name: BRAF V600E — Vemurafenib selectivity
cases.literature: Bollag et al., Nature 2010 — Vemurafenib (PLX4032) is V600E-selective; ~30 nM against V600E vs ~100 nM against WT BRAF.
cases.verdict_note: |Δ|=0.70 below ±1.0 kcal/mol noise floor; direction is correct (selectivity for V600E) but magnitude shrunk vs the prior pre-minimisation -2.90 kcal/mol — the relaxed mutant pocket admits a slightly less favourable Vemurafenib pose. A single sampling at exhaustiveness=8 has wide variance; a higher-exhaustiveness re-run would clarify whether the prior -2.90 was lucky or this -0.70 is unlucky.

cases.name: BTK C481S — Ibrutinib covalent escape
cases.literature: Woyach et al., NEJM 2014 — C481S ablates the covalent cysteine target of Ibrutinib; >100-fold cellular IC50 loss in CLL.
cases.caveat: Ibrutinib's WT advantage is COVALENT (acrylamide → C481 thiol). Vina is non-covalent — the residual non-covalent ΔΔG should still be positive (S smaller than C, slight pocket reshape).
cases.verdict_note: Δ=+1.40 kcal/mol matches expected 'resistance' — non-covalent component of the Ibrutinib loss is now resolved above noise (was NOISE before OpenMM minimisation step landed)

cases.name: BTK C481S — Pirtobrutinib retention
cases.literature: Mato et al., NEJM 2021 — Pirtobrutinib is non-covalent; retains potency against C481S (cellular IC50 essentially unchanged).
cases.verdict_note: Δ=+1.00 kcal/mol disagrees with literature 'retained' direction — sits exactly at the noise floor edge. Investigation: the OpenMM-relaxed C481S mutant may have shifted the pocket geometry in a way that subtly disadvantages Pirtobrutinib's non-covalent binding mode. Re-running at exhaustiveness=16 or 32 would tighten the noise band and clarify whether this is sampling variance or a real method limitation.
